comment: Release DMG window (tools/package-dmg.sh). Read by tools/gen-dmg-background.swift and tools/gen-dmg-layout.py; points from the top left of the window content. Colors name design tokens as theme.token, text styles name typography tokens (redesign/design/tokens). Finder draws item labels in dark text on a picture background in both appearances, so every item and its label sit inside a light card.
